personalInfo.name: Carlos Gomez, MSc
personalInfo.title: Senior Data Engineer / Head of Data Department
personalInfo.summary: Data engineer and analytics platform owner with 14+ years building production data pipelines, warehouses, and decision-support systems. Track record of single-handedly shipping and maintaining production Python + SQL platforms at scale (200+ scheduled jobs, 297 SQL pipelines, 119 Python modules, 0→377 tests), reducing time-to-detect from days to minutes.

experience.title: Senior Data Engineer / Head of Data Department
experience.description: Owner of the Game Analytics ETL platform powering analytics for live games (Battle Pirates, War Commander, Vega Conflict). Sole data-department member — sets technical direction, ships work, runs on-call.
achievements: Eliminated silent ETL failures across ~200-job Snowflake pipeline, reducing time-to-detect from days to minutes by routing failures to Slack.
Built automated test suite from 0 to 377 passing tests (all external services mocked), enabling safe refactors of a 119-module framework with no regressions.
Removed hardcoded credentials (Snowflake key, Slack/AWS tokens) by moving secrets to environment/.env with regression tests.
Closed SQL-injection vectors across all ETL drivers by enforcing identifier/string-escaping helpers.
Decommissioned 3 retired games by removing ~310 ETL files and 47 scheduled jobs using a reversible process with audit logs.
Hardened DataFrame→Snowflake loader (header sanitization, de-duplication), converting cryptic crashes into clear alerts.

experience.title: Senior Analytics Manager
experience.description: Owned data architecture, governance, and analytics for marketing and live games.
achievements: Built marketing data pipeline pulling AppsFlyer API data into the warehouse on cron schedule.
Cut manual tasks by 34% by instrumenting cron-job automation and unifying data extraction with downstream reporting.
Designed statistical and ML revenue-forecast models (AutoTS, TensorFlow) for marketing-spend decisions.
Integrated Slack with reporting to surface data in the right channel, improving stakeholder efficiency by 13%.

experience.title: Product Manager (Analytics & Live Ops)
experience.description: Managed event design, mobile-game live operations, analytics, and process optimization.
achievements: Improved event setup efficiency by 73% and reduced human errors by 33% through tooling and process enhancements.
Cut dashboard creation time by 30% by designing and shipping a BP data warehouse with semantic-layer models (LookML).
Built a statistical forecast model with ±5% error that informed unit design and yearly event seasons.
Designed and shipped A/B test experiments that boosted D1 retention by 7% and playing time by 10%.

experience.title: Software Consultant
experience.description: Developed a web platform for the BC Ministry of Education and led DevOps for continued deployment.
achievements: Cut new-developer setup time from 1 week to 1 hour by automating local developer environment setup.
Saved $70K/year by refactoring the platform front end with Bootstrap + JavaScript + jQuery.
Shipped CI/CD with Jenkins + Selenium + Docker + JBoss.
